% Beamer source: the usual title frame with an attribution line after
% \maketitle. Renders fine under Beamer. C-TITLEPAGE records that under ltx-talk
% \maketitle produces a full, vertically-centred frame, so the attribution prints
% ON TOP of the title -- a known 0.5.0 limitation.
%
% ⚠ THAT SYMPTOM IS GONE, and the entry is retired. It did not reproduce on
% 0.5.3 (measured 2026-08-24) and does not reproduce on 0.6.2 (measured
% 2026-09-10). The "maybe the trigger needs more than a minimal frame"
% hypothesis was tested and does NOT hold: plain \maketitle plus a long
% multi-line attribution block, plus a no-\vfill variant, plus \maketitle
% outside any frame, all place the attribution clear of the title (61pt of gap
% in the minimal case). Numbers are in the C-TITLEPAGE entry.
%
% This fixture deliberately has NO naive.tex. A variant asserting a defect that
% no longer exists would report ADVISORY on every run for ever. The consequence
% is that nothing here would notice the overlap coming back.
%
% after.tex is kept because \coursetitlepage is still a reasonable title frame
% -- now as a styling choice, not as a workaround. See #7.
\documentclass{beamer}

\title{Constraint Satisfaction}
\author{A. Lecturer}
\institute{University of Somewhere}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}
\maketitle
\vfill
{\footnotesize Material adapted from Russell \& Norvig.}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
